commitMessageFormat.title: Commit message format ({id} and {summary} are replaced; local tasks have no ID)

fillCommitTemplate.title: Write the active task's commit message to git's commit.template, which pre-fills the commit field (needs git; a template you set yourself is left alone)

branchNameFormat.title: Branch name format ({id} and {summary} are replaced; local tasks have no ID, so an empty name falls back to the first two words of the summary)

githubRepository.title: GitHub repository as owner/name (leave empty to use the github.com remote)

githubAssignedOnly.title: GitHub: only issues assigned to me

gitlabProject.title: GitLab project as group/name (leave empty to use the gitlab.com remote, or all your issues if there is none)

forgejoRepository.title: Codeberg repository as owner/name (leave empty to use the codeberg.org remote)

youtrackHost.title: YouTrack Cloud host, such as acme.youtrack.cloud

youtrackCloseState.title: YouTrack state to set when closing a task

jiraHost.title: Jira Cloud host, such as acme.atlassian.net

jiraQuery.title: Jira JQL query
jiraQuery.default: assignee = currentUser() and resolution = Unresolved order by updated
